title: Davis told definitively that we are monitored and do not control our space

tellings.quote: 100. Because it was definitive. It was that was told to me definitively, not speculatively. It was we know this to be true.

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis, who has worked as a scientist for the Pentagon, says he was told as fact that humanity is being watched and does not control its own airspace or the space around Earth. Davis says he is one hundred percent sure of this because it was told to him "definitively, not speculatively," as in "we know this to be true," though he does not name who told him. If true, it would mean someone inside government knows another presence is watching us.
